_comment: Free-tier quotas and notes per source (as of 2026-11). Key is the module name.
certspotter: No key: ~10 requests/hour, 1 page, only unexpired certificates
hackertarget: Passive DNS, ~20-50 requests/day per IP, no key
shodan_dns: Dev plan: 100 query credits/month (1 credit per /dns/domain page)
shodan_idb: host API without credits (own key or shodan_dns key); port observation dates
fullhunt: Free: 10 credits/month (1 request = 1 credit, up to 500 results)
leakix: Free: ~1 req/s, ~3000 requests; last_seen and distinct_ips
ip2location: No key: 1000/day (geo, ASN, is_proxy); free key 50K/month
hunterio: Free: 50 searches/month; page_size=10 (limit=100 returns 400 on Free)
github_org: No token: 60 req/hour, with a PAT 5000/hour
postman: Free: 10,000 API calls/month; max_workspaces=50 per query
criminalip: Free; reads existing reports, never starts a new scan
netlas: No key: 1 page (20 domains); Community key 50 requests/day
shodanct: No key: ctl.shodan.io, subdomains from certificate SANs
crt: crt.sh, no key; large domains often time out
urlscan: Limited without a key; with a key: size and IP/ASN
wayback: CDX without a key, showResumeKey pagination
trufflehog: No key; exclude_paths drops third-party code; verify is off
thc: ip.thc.org, no key; 250-request bucket refilled at 0.5/s
robtex: Free passive DNS, no key; records older than 90 days tagged pdns-historical
commoncrawl: No key; the N latest crawls (default 2)
fofa: Key required; size up to 10,000, paginated
related_domains: No network: validates relations from the DNS records of the target and candidates
